title: Kumano Kodo
subtitle: An ancient pilgrimage through cedar and mist

cover.alt: Stone steps through a misty cedar forest

chapters.heading: A thousand-year-old path
chapters.body: Moss-covered stone steps worn smooth by pilgrims since before castles. The forest was so quiet I could hear my own heartbeat.

chapters.heading: Onsen and tatami
chapters.body: Every evening ended in hot spring water and a ten-course dinner I didn't deserve and devoured anyway.
